answer_1.quote: We are the first to propose the use of citation to alleviate hallucination in a post-hoc way with regeneration.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating reliable responses in dialogue systems by mitigating hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs through a citation-enhanced generation framework.

answer_2.quote: The Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUC-PR) and Balanced_Accuracy are adopted as evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: We prefer to utilize an LLM with predefined prompts to serve as the NLI method.

answer_4.quote: We conduct manual annotation to assess whether the original passages can support the rewritten claims by three annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Each sample is initially annotated by two human annotators. In cases where there are discrepancies between the annotations provided by the two annotators, the final label is determined by consensus among three annotators.
